name: Being Meek
overview: Scripture teaches that meekness is a Christlike humility characterized by a lowly heart and a sober view of oneself, as demonstrated by Jesus who invites us to learn from His meekness to find true rest. The Beatitudes affirm that the meek are blessed and will inherit the earth, highlighting the spiritual blessing and future reward for those who embody this attitude. Meekness involves recognizing our spiritual poverty and hungering for righteousness, relying wholly on God's grace and faith rather than self-exaltation.
